== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Javik Leed, also known as the [[Yellow Knight]], is a dark-skinned human and a former member of the [[Titan Force]]. Serving as an [[Aether Technician]], he possesses a specialized affinity for performing repairs. During his time with the [[Titan Force]], he operated the [[Yellow Titan]], a vessel capable of summoning heavy weaponry from [[Subspace]], such as two-handed cannons and massive guns. His service included a conflict against Neth’therith, which resulted in the destruction of his [[Divine Titan]] and required extensive medical treatment and years of recovery to restore him to health. In his later years, Javik retired to live with his family on [[Nyron Seven]]. While in recovery, he utilized a hover-chair for mobility and worked with a therapist to manage his temper. Despite not being a [[Combat Artist]], he is proficient with firearms, including automatic mag-rifles and heavy two-handed rifles. He has a history of working alongside [[Raion Raithe|Raion]], though they occasionally held differing views on professional seriousness. During an emergency, Javik demonstrated his willingness to protect others and assist his former associates by coordinating with his family and preparing for combat.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Javik Leed is a [[Titan Knight]] who held the title of the [[Yellow Knight]] and was associated with the [[Yellow Titan]].
